title: Geo-Simulating Climate Extreme-Induced Human Migration Patterns using Agent-Based Modeling and Machine Learning
description: Replication codebase and simulation pipeline coupling deep learning (BiLSTM-Attention), ensemble machine learning (LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost + SHAP), and Mesa-Geo agent-based modeling to simulate climate-induced displacement across South and Southeast Asia (2008–2023).
